verdict.rationale: Anytype doesn't ship a native, built-in AI chat assistant inside the app; instead it exposes a local API, MCP server, and an 'Agents Skill' that let external AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) read/search/modify Objects within a Channel, with docs stressing safe, scoped access. This satisfies 'grounded in my own notes with data controls' but not the 'built-in assistant' framing — the AI lives outside the app, not inside it. Missing for 10: a native in-app assistant UI for Q&A/summarization/drafting, and independent hands-on confirmation of the MCP/agent workflow actually answering/summarizing well.
